title: DF-VERIFY/1 — station-receipt/v1 profile (We Sign Your Station)
description: A signed, tamper-evident record that a registered station REPORTED a reading at a moment, produced by POST /v1/station/reading. HONEST PROVENANCE: Dynamic Feed did NOT measure the value, the station operator did; the receipt states this in words (observation.measured_by and observation.source). SCOPE: attests what the station reported, NOT that the sensor is calibrated and NOT that the value is accurate; corroborate with an independent source where one exists. Detached Ed25519 signature over the object minus its `signature`, json-sorted-compact; independently time-stampable by an independent RFC 3161 authority via /v1/anchor. Advisory evidence, not a certification, never the money path.

witnessed_at.description: when Dynamic Feed witnessed the station's report

observed_at.description: when the station reports it measured the value

measured_by.description: states the station operator measured it, not Dynamic Feed

source_count.description: number of independent sources (1 when only the station reported)

single_source.description: true unless an independent Dynamic Feed feed corroborated the quantity at the station's location

concordance.description: present when Dynamic Feed's own independent feed for the quantity at the station's location could cross-check the report; carries an honest agree/diverge/single_source/degraded verdict (concordance/v1). The station and Dynamic Feed are distinct provenance roots.
